tag: Studio BELEM / Building permit, December 2025 / Housing, shop and car park

narrative.text: The flood-risk prevention plan (PPRI) requires the whole building to be raised to 29.5 NGF, about 1.6 m above natural ground. The permit notice turns this into a plinth of bonded, perforated brick on which the two blocks sit: two offset low walls holding a continuous planter, so that the street is partly planted at passers-by's height. On the plinth, the active uses of the raised ground floor are arranged within a covered passage, wide open to the street, that links the two blocks; a semi-buried car park lies beneath, about 2.0 m below natural ground. A shop, at natural ground level, occupies the south end of block A, at the corner of avenue de Verdun and rue de l'Avenir.
narrative.source: hq:Villneuve la garenne/PC40-2_DOCUMENTS DESCRIPTIFS SECURITE INCENDIE ERP_merge [121-140]_page-0001.jpg (architectural notice PC 4, page 8: 'La contrainte réglementaire liée au PPRI impose une surélévation générale du bâtiment jusqu'à la cote 29,5 NGF […] Un commerce, implanté au niveau du sol naturel, occupe la partie Sud du plot A, à l'angle de l'avenue de Verdun et de la rue de l'Avenir.'; translated, D17)

narrative.text: The materials notice names bio-sourced materials (timber windows, French windows and curtain walls; timber decking or slabs on pedestals for the terraces), a geo-sourced substrate for the planted roofs, and reused solid brick.
narrative.source: hq:Villneuve la garenne/PC40-2_DOCUMENTS DESCRIPTIFS SECURITE INCENDIE ERP_merge [141-160] [11-20]_page-0005.jpg (materials notice PC 10-1, page 5, '3/ PROVENANCES DES MATÉRIAUX': 'Matériaux biosourcés', 'Matériaux géosourcés', 'Matériaux issus du réemploi : Brique pleine.'; translated, D17)

figures.title: Site plan
figures.caption: Fire-safety site plan, PC40 sheet, 1/500, December 2025. The corner block (R+7) on avenue de Verdun and the lower block (R+5) along rue de l'Avenir, joined by an R+1 link. The fire hydrant stands on avenue de Verdun, 60.41 m from the shop entrance.
figures.alt: Site plan: two pale blocks on a narrow plot along rue de l'Avenir, the square corner block and the long lower block, a curved link between them, avenue de Verdun on the left, houses and trees around, and red and green access marks
figures.source: hq:Villneuve la garenne/PC40-2_DOCUMENTS DESCRIPTIFS SECURITE INCENDIE ERP_merge [1-20]_page-0003.jpg (printed title 'PC40 - Dossier destiné à la vérification de la conformité aux règles de sécurité incendie', 'Plan masse securité', scale 1/500; legend 'Distance borne - établissement', 'Borne incendie', 'Sortie de secours', 'Accès à l'établissement'; labels 'Accès Logement', 'Accès Parking', 'Accès Commerce', '60,41 m'; translated, D17)

figures.title: Raised ground floor
figures.caption: Plan N0H, 1/200, December 2025. On avenue de Verdun (left), the shop (95.76 m²) with its entrance and emergency exit, then the service rooms, the hall of block A and flat A01. The residents' entrance opens from rue de l'Avenir (top) onto the covered passage between the blocks; block B holds four flats (B01 to B04), its hall and stores for 20 and 60 bicycles, with the parking and bicycle accesses at the right.
figures.alt: Ground-floor plan in black, red and blue: a long shop along the left edge, a stair core and service rooms, a paved passage with an arc, the lower block with four flats around a central stair, bicycle racks, and a curved ramp at the right end; the street with parked cars along the top
figures.source: hq:Villneuve la garenne/PC40-2_DOCUMENTS DESCRIPTIFS SECURITE INCENDIE ERP_merge [1-20]_page-0009.jpg (printed title 'ANX0 - PLAN PROJET', 'Plan N0H', scale 1/200; labels 'Local commercial 95,76 m²', 'Sortie de secours commerce', 'Accès piéton aux logements', 'Accès Logement A', 'Accès Logement B', '20 Vélos', '60 Vélos', 'Accès parking', 'Accès vélo', 'A01', 'B01'-'B04'; translated, D17)

figures.title: Basement, first floor and top floor
figures.caption: Plans SS1, N01 and N07, 1/200, December 2025, top to bottom. The car park under both blocks, with 36 numbered spaces (two for disabled drivers), the pedestrian exits and the curved ramp; level 1, with flats in both blocks around their stair cores; level 7, the top floor of the corner block (flats A71 and A72), beside the roof of the lower block.

items.alt: Basement plan in a hatched ground: numbered parking bays along both sides of a central aisle, a stair and lift at the left with a shop store below, and a curved ramp at the right
First-floor plan: the square corner block with four flats around a central stair at the left, an arched opening over the passage, and the long block with six flats around its stair at the right
Seventh-floor plan: two flats in the corner block at the left and, at the right, the roof of the long block with its roof outlets

Levels from +25.95 NGF in the basement to +52.95 NGF at the top of the corner block.
